title: pr-pane 0.6.0: tell people how to get the docked pane
summary: Detect the session's layout and width, and explain how to get the pane docked beside the conversation.
description: A Windows user's pane showed below the conversation while Jeremy's (macOS) docks on the right. Placement depends on Claude Code's layout, not the OS: the fullscreen layout docks a pane beside the transcript from 110 columns; the default layout places it inline above the prompt. Jeremy asked whether pr-pane can check this and tell people how to turn it on. Per the Claude Code docs, /tui fullscreen saves 'tui: fullscreen' and relaunches keeping the conversation; /tui default reverts it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: /prs layout reports the layout (fullscreen or default) and terminal width from command.run presentation, and how to get the docked pane: /tui fullscreen when the layout is default, a wider window when fullscreen is under 110 columns
/prs and /prs show add the same advice as a one-line tip when the pane cannot dock, until the person has run /prs layout
While the pane is drawn inline, it shows one dim tip line until the person has run /prs layout; the seen flag persists across sessions in $.store
pr-pane never changes the layout setting itself
Tests cover the advice for default, narrow fullscreen and wide fullscreen, the tip in /prs output, and the in-pane tip disappearing after /prs layout; validate --strict, plugin test and tsc pass

implementationNotes: How-to source: a claude-code-guide lookup of code.claude.com/docs (settings-reference 'tui', fullscreen.md, env-vars.md): /tui fullscreen saves the setting and relaunches keeping the conversation; /tui default reverts; tui accepts fullscreen or default; fullscreen works in tmux (needs set -g mouse on for wheel scrolling). The docs don't confirm Windows parity, so the advice relies on the live isFullscreen value rather than the OS.

AC1-AC3, AC5: tests/layout.test.ts (advice for default, 109 and 110 columns; the report; the tip text) and tests/pane.test.ts ('/prs layout' with each presentation; the inline-only pane tip and the /prs show tip, both gone after /prs layout, with layoutSeen stored; no tip with isInteractive false). Mutations that ignore the seen flag or the interactive gate fail 1 and 2 tests. 52/52, tsc 0 errors, validate --strict.
AC4: the code makes no $.config.set or settings write for the layout; layout.ts only returns text.
